status: DRAFT by claude-2 at Joe's direction ("we may need some intermediate theses for me to make more immediate judgements ... and you too"); each one is a rule of judgement that sits between the apex thesis and a backlog row, and names the record that decides it

theses.text: A mission whose Place is down is blocked only if the Place is coming back; otherwise it needs rehoming, which is work. It is retired only when its need is met elsewhere or dropped with an explanation.
theses.decided-by: the Place probe for the fact; Joe 2026-11-02 on the futon1a rows ("still look open to me"): a standing acceptance checklist keeps an item open while its Place is down; claude-16 2026-11-02: a blocker means something only if the thing could come back
theses.settled-today: 12 probed: 6 retired with a target, 5 reopened as blocked, 1 clustered

theses.text: A closure without an independent witness is a reading, not a completion.
theses.decided-by: a registry warrant, a cascade-real arrow, or a commit that produced the named artifact (C6: 0 of 12 live-gap closings had one)

theses.text: A held item is open only if the holder and the un-hold condition are both named.
theses.decided-by: the hold reason in the mission file; otherwise it is retired or merged

theses.text: Completed work is attested upward: every closure names the therefore it served and the witness; a retired row with a carry attests nothing upward.
theses.decided-by: an attestation per closed row, rendered under its therefore

theses.text: The War Machine may select only from the set that survives IT-1 to IT-3 and names who acts.
theses.decided-by: the outermost loop's selectable count on this page

theses.text: Dropping a need carries the same explanatory burden as closing it: the record says what it was for and why it is no longer wanted, on the page.
theses.decided-by: Joe 2026-11-02: "'dropped' would also need an explanation for Cascade Live so we can't dodge the explanatory burden"

theses.text: Combine upward without supersession: when two items share a need, they join a cluster node that names it; a merge that would lose a constituent's meaning is a cluster instead.
A disposition says what kind of thing an item was: a prototype we can learn from closes with what it taught; a feature under development stays open with its next step.
theses.decided-by: Joe 2026-11-02 on the EOI workflow versus Minus40°DB
